name: Cu/Au Ratio ROC Quartiles vs S&P 500 Forward Returns
description: Sorts the 63-day ROC of the copper/gold ratio into quartiles using rolling 252-day percentrank (Q1=most falling, Q4=most rising) and measures SPY forward 3-month returns in each quartile. Tests whether extreme readings (Q4 vs Q1) produce meaningfully different outcomes. Uses LiquidityBased continuation for HG and GC futures.
source:
# Cu/Au Ratio ROC Quartile Sort → SPY Forward 3-Month Returns
# Signal: 63-day ROC of HG/GC ratio, bucketed into quartiles via rolling 252d percentrank
# Q1 = bottom 25% (most falling / risk aversion), Q4 = top 25% (most rising / optimism)
# Response: SPY forward 63-day return in each quartile

# --- Data ---
spy = market_data_source()()
close = spy.c

# Copper (HG) via reference futures + continuation
hg_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.HG)()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)

# Gold (GC) via reference futures + continuation
gc_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.GC)()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio & 63-Day ROC ---
cu_au_ratio = hg_close / gc_close
ratio_roc = roc(period=63)(cu_au_ratio)

# --- Quartile Classification via Rolling 252-Day Percentrank ---
# percentrank returns 0-100; bucket into quartiles
roc_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(ratio_roc)

is_q1 = is_valid(roc_pctrank) and roc_pctrank <= 25
is_q2 = is_valid(roc_pctrank) and roc_pctrank > 25 and roc_pctrank <= 50
is_q3 = is_valid(roc_pctrank) and roc_pctrank > 50 and roc_pctrank <= 75
is_q4 = is_valid(roc_pctrank) and roc_pctrank > 75

# Quartile label for event markers
quartile_label = conditional_select(is_q1, "Q1 (Falling)", is_q2, "Q2", is_q3, "Q3", is_q4, "Q4 (Rising)", "N/A")

# --- Forward Returns (SPY) ---
fwd_3m = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Regime-filtered forward returns per quartile
fwd_q1 = where(is_q1, fwd_3m)
fwd_q2 = where(is_q2, fwd_3m)
fwd_q3 = where(is_q3, fwd_3m)
fwd_q4 = where(is_q4, fwd_3m)

# Hit rates per quartile (1.0 if positive, 0.0 if negative, NaN if no data)
hit_q1 = where(is_q1 and is_valid(fwd_3m), 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q2 = where(is_q2 and is_valid(fwd_3m), 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q3 = where(is_q3 and is_valid(fwd_3m), 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q4 = where(is_q4 and is_valid(fwd_3m), 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Chart 1: Punchline — Median 3M SPY Return by Quartile ---
# The key question: do extreme quartiles produce different outcomes?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title="Do Extreme Cu/Au ROC Readings Predict SPY Returns?",
    category="Cu/Au ROC Quartiles",
    x_axis_label="Cu/Au 63d ROC Quartile",
    y_axis_label="Median Fwd 3M SPY Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q1 (Most Falling)", color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q2", color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q3", color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q4 (Most Rising)", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4))

# --- Chart 2: Hit Rate by Quartile — How Often Is the Return Positive? ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title="How Often Are 3M Returns Positive by Quartile?",
    category="Cu/Au ROC Quartiles",
    x_axis_label="Cu/Au 63d ROC Quartile",
    y_axis_label="Hit Rate (% Positive)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q1 (Most Falling)", color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q2", color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q3", color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q4 (Most Rising)", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="50%")
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(hit_q1, hit_q2, hit_q3, hit_q4))

# --- Summary Table: Full Stats by Quartile ---
# N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst — the desk reference
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category="Cu/Au ROC Quartiles",
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="3-Month Forward SPY Return Stats by ROC Quartile",
        row_size=5, col_size=4,
        row_headers=["Daily Obs (N)", "Median Return", "Hit Rate (% Pos)", "Best", "Worst"],
        col_headers=["Q1 (Most Falling)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (Most Rising)"],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: N (Count)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Median Return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 2: Hit Rate (Mean of 1/0 series)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 3: Best (Max)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 4: Worst (Min)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, hit_q1, hit_q2, hit_q3, hit_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4)

# --- Event Markers: Extreme Quartile Entries (Q1 or Q4) ---
# Detect transitions INTO extreme quartiles
prev_q1 = is_q1 >> 1
prev_q4 = is_q4 >> 1
enter_q1 = is_q1 and not prev_q1
enter_q4 = is_q4 and not prev_q4
is_extreme_entry = enter_q1 or enter_q4

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Extreme Cu/Au ROC Quartile Entry",
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Quartile", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="ROC Percentile", dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="63d ROC", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="SPY Close", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(quartile_label, roc_pctrank, ratio_roc, close, is_extreme_entry)
